intro: Body contouring covers non-surgical treatments that reduce localised pockets of fat and improve skin firmness in areas that diet and exercise do not seem to reach: the lower abdomen, flanks, upper arms, inner thighs and under the chin. It is a shaping treatment for people close to their healthy weight, not a substitute for weight loss.

Results are gradual and depend on the area, the technique and your own metabolism. A course of sessions is needed, changes become visible over 8 to 12 weeks, and the result is maintained by keeping your weight stable. Dr. Daksha Patel, an MD dermatologist, assesses each patient at Skin Essence in person, with measurements and photographs, and explains which areas are realistic targets and which are not.

On Indian skin, heat-based treatments carry a risk of pigmentation if settings are wrong, so the technique and settings are chosen for your area, skin type and goals and explained at consultation. Patients at our Kalyani Nagar clinic who would be better served by surgery are told so and referred, rather than sold sessions that will disappoint.
whoIsItFor: Stubborn fat pockets on the abdomen, flanks, arms or thighs despite regular exercise
Post-pregnancy laxity of the lower abdomen
A double chin that does not improve with weight loss
Men with love handles or chest fullness close to their healthy weight
Not suitable as a treatment for obesity, and not a replacement for diet and exercise

howItWorks.title: Assessment
howItWorks.description: Measurements, photographs, weight and skin laxity are recorded, and we discuss what you want to change and what is achievable without surgery.

howItWorks.title: Plan
howItWorks.description: Areas, number of sessions, expected change and maintenance are set out in writing, along with the technique and settings chosen for your skin.

howItWorks.title: Sessions
howItWorks.description: Each area takes 45 to 60 minutes. You feel warmth, cold or pulling depending on the technique, with no anaesthesia and no needles for most areas.

howItWorks.title: Results and lifestyle
howItWorks.description: Changes appear gradually over 8 to 12 weeks as the body clears treated fat. Progress is measured at each review, and maintaining your weight preserves the result.

sessionsAndDowntime.downtime: None; mild redness, tenderness or numbness for a few days

aftercare: Drink plenty of water and stay active; walking helps the body clear treated fat.
Wear light compression if advised for the treated area.
Avoid heavy meals and alcohol on the day of each session.
Keep your weight stable; gaining weight after treatment refills the area.

faqs.q: Is body contouring a weight-loss treatment?
faqs.a: No. It reshapes specific areas by reducing localised fat and improving firmness. It works best for people within a few kilograms of their healthy weight who have stubborn pockets.
Commonly the abdomen, flanks, upper arms, inner and outer thighs, and under the chin. Suitability of each area is confirmed at the assessment.
Most techniques cause warmth, cold or a pulling sensation rather than pain, and need no anaesthesia. Mild tenderness or numbness for a few days afterwards is normal.
Treated fat cells do not return, but remaining cells can enlarge with weight gain and skin continues to age. Keeping your weight stable maintains the result.
No. Body contouring here is non-surgical. If your goals need surgical results, we tell you honestly and refer you rather than start a course that cannot deliver.
